'''March 2002 Richland tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Richland, Washington on 30 March 2002. It is known from Kelly Brown's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3553">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-02-richland-washington-03-30-2002d3553/ richland-washington-03-30-2002], DeckTech (Kelly "Gyrotech" Brown, 2 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-02-richland-washington-03-30-2002d3553/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 March 2002
* '''Site:''' Richland, Washington
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
